findings.evidenceJa: それで、どうにかなるんなら
findings.governingReading: それでどうにかなるんなら conditions his assent on the plan offering a way forward.
findings.explanation: Agreement if it helps becomes a promise to make it work.

findings.highlight: I didn't expect you to say that you'd be okay with taking off the shroud.
findings.evidenceJa: あっさり言うとは思わなかった
findings.governingReading: あっさり言うとは思わなかった specifies how easily she thinks he agreed, despite his narrated struggle and her expected answer.
findings.explanation: Unexpected ease of assent becomes unexpected assent itself.

findings.highlight: I wouldn't make you take off the shroud.
findings.evidenceJa: 決して聖骸布を外させない
findings.governingReading: 決して外させない means she will never permit his taking the cloth off, unpacking the arm-use ban.
findings.explanation: Rin’s prohibition on removing cloth becomes no compulsion to remove it.
